content:
Here is a production-ready Crossplane XRD and Composition implementing the specified resources using the modern **Functions mode** (`function-patch-and-transform`). The design is parameterized to support idiomatic `dev`/`prod` environment isolation.

### 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)
Defines the schema, environment parameters, and connection secret handling for the DB credentials.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: spines.x.example.com
spec:
  group: x.example.com
  names:
    kind: Spine
    plural: spines
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  description: Environment-specific infrastructure configuration
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum: [dev, prod]
                      default: dev
                    region:
                      type: string
                      default: us-east-1
                    
                    # S3 Bucket
                    bucketSseAlgorithm:
                      type: string
                      enum: [AES256, aws:kms]
                      default: AES256
                    
                    # RDS PostgreSQL
                    rdsInstanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: db.t3.micro
                    rdsMultiAz:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    rdsEncrypted:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    rdsBackupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      default: 7
                    rdsDeletionProtection:
                      type: boolean
                      default: true
                    
                    # IAM Role
                    iamRoleName:
                      type: string
                      default: spine-sa-role
                    iamTrustPolicy:
                      type: object
                      description: IAM assume role policy document (JSON)
                    iamPolicyArn:
                      type: string
                      description: ARN of managed policy to attach (least-privilege)
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  description: Reference to a Kubernetes Secret to store DB connection details
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    name:
                      type: string
                    namespace:
                      type: string
              required:
                - parameters
                - writeConnectionSecretToRef
```

### 2. Composition (Functions Mode)
Uses `function-patch-and-transform` to map XR parameters to managed AWS resources. Dependencies are resolved automatically via patch selectors.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: spine.composition.x.example.com
compositeResourceRef:
  apiVersion: x.example.com/v1alpha1
  kind: Spine
mode: Functions
functions:
  - ref:
      name: function-patch-and-transform

resources:
  # 1. S3 Bucket with versioning, encryption, and public access block
  - name: s3-bucket
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: spine-assets
      spec:
        forProvider:
          region: us-east-1
          versioningConfiguration:
            - status: Enabled
          serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - rules:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionConfigurationByDefault:
                    sseAlgorithm: AES256
                  bucketKeyEnabled: true
          publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
            - blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
    patches:
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: metadata.name
        toFieldPath: metadata.name
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketSseAlgorithm
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.serverSideEncryptionConfiguration[0].rules[0].applyServerSideEncryptionConfigurationByDefault.sseAlgorithm

  # 2. RDS PostgreSQL Instance
  - name: rds-postgres
    base:
      apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Instance
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: spine-db
      spec:
        forProvider:
          region: us-east-1
          dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
          engine: postgres
          engineVersion: "15.4"
          multiAZ: false
          storageEncrypted: false
          deletionProtection: true
          backupRetentionPeriod: 7
          publiclyAccessible: false
          allocatedStorage: 20
          dbName: spineapp
          masterUsername: spineadmin
          masterUserSecretKmsKeyId: alias/aws/rds
          skipFinalSnapshotBeforeDeletion: true
    patches:
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsInstanceClass
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbInstanceClass
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsMultiAz
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsEncrypted
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsBackupRetentionDays
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsDeletionProtection
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deletionProtection

  # 3. IAM Role for Service Accounts
  - name: iam-sa-role
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: spine-iam
      spec:
        forProvider:
          assumeRolePolicyDocument: '{}'
          path: /system/
          tags:
            ManagedBy: crossplane
    patches:
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.iamRoleName
        toFieldPath: metadata.name
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
        fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.iamTrustPolicy
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicyDocument

  # 4. IAM Role Policy Attachment
  - name: iam-sa-policy-attachment
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: RolePolicyAttachment
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: spine-iam
      spec:
        forProvider:
          policyArn: ""
          role: ""
    patches:
      - type: Selectors
        fromFieldPath: spec.resourceRef
        toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
        selectors:
          - matchControllerRef: true
            matchLabels:
              app: spine-iam
      - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
